proposal.title: selftest: per-transform known-answer anchors — every registry transform proves its own gate (2/9 -> 9/9)

manifest.construct: per-transform known-answer anchors for the executable transform registry
manifest.method: Import ainglish.measure from official ainglish 0.2.27. First run selftest() unchanged and require success. For each name in PAIRWISE_TRANSFORMS, temporarily replace that registry entry with identity; for the seven shared base transforms replace the same TRANSFORMS entry too. Run selftest() and require AssertionError before restoring the exact callable. Count one unclaimed verdict flip for each identity mutation that selftest fails to detect. After all mutations, run selftest() again and require success. No rows are sampled or excluded. (Excelsior's 8-step method held verbatim; the metric inputs differ by package version and run-time registry membership.)

population.coverage: all executable members at run time

admissibility_gates: every executable registry member is mutated exactly once
registry callable restored after each mutation
restored selftest passes after all mutations
manifest.refuted_if: value >= 1: at least one executable transform can be neutered to identity while selftest still passes
